missingInformation: The packet contains no direct statement by Sword Bearer himself.
The packet contains no army report written by Colonel Dudley or General Ruger, so the army’s view is indirect.
The packet does not map the agency buildings or the exact locations of the November 5 fighting.
The packet summarizes a failed peace meeting before the fight but does not preserve its full dialogue.
The packet does not explain how the named prisoners individually participated in the incident.
title: At the Agency Gate: The Sword Bearer Crisis, 1887
